figures.title: Figure 3
figures.llm_description: Figure 3. a, b, 3D view of AFM topographical images of a 2D grating and a 2D micro disk array respectively.  c–e, Optical microscopy images of logo of IIT Kanpur, an array of micro pillars of height 6 m and a 2D disk   array respectively. All these microstructures  are fabricated using the parameters: 1.2 mW laser average power, 100 m/s writing speed, 10 kHz rep rate and  0.8 NA objective.

figures.llm_description: Figure 4. AFM topographical image of a 2D grating fabricated using  100X oil immersion objective in SU-8. (Inset) The corresponding line  profile of selected portion of the line. FWHM of the corresponding line  profile is around 500 nm.

figures.title: Figure 5
figures.llm_description: Figure 5. a, AFM topographical image of micro lines array fabricated in SU-8 at constant writing speed 100 m/s with decreas-ing peak intensity of 5.7 GW/cm2 to 2.5 GW/cm2 (from left to right). b, Micro lines array fabricated in SU-8 at constant peak   intensity 4.6 GW/cm2 with increasing writing speed of 300 to 1600 m/s (from left to right). c, d, Corresponding line profiles of  (a) and (b) respectively.

figures.title: Figure 6
